# S75 — Run directory and role temp directory modes; old run.json and vendor reports

S51 (decided #106, state.run-json-mode) made the files ork writes in a run directory 0600. Its run report left three cases open: the run directory (internal/runrec/store.go:73 and :76) and the per-round temp directory (internal/engine/round.go:165) are still created 0755; a role report written by a vendor CLI keeps the vendor's file mode, and only ork's own fallback report is 0600; a run.json written before S51 stays 0644 until the next save.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

A recorded command can hold a secret (S51). The files are 0600 now, but a 0755 directory still lets any local user list the run and round names, and an old run.json stays readable. The owner has not decided any of the three cases.

## Files

- `internal/runrec/store.go:73` and :76 (run directory and run subdirectory), `internal/engine/round.go:165` (per-round temp directory), their tests, `docs/state.md`.
- Reference only: `internal/engine/states.go:76` creates the parent of the git exclude file (not a run file); leave it.

## Failing tests

- TestRunDirectoriesAre0700: after a run starts, the run directory (store.go:73), the run subdirectory (:76) and a per-round temp directory (round.go:165) have mode 0700 (check with os.Stat; skip the mode check on a platform without Unix modes).
- TestSaveTightensAnOldRunDirectory: a run directory created 0755 with an old run.json is 0700 after the next save, and the file keeps 0600.
- TestLoadDoesNotChangeModes: listing or loading runs changes no mode (tighten on save only, owner 2026-10-23).
- TestVendorReportModeIsLeftAlone: a role report written by a fake vendor at 0644 keeps 0644.

## Implement

Create the run directory, the run subdirectory and each per-round temp directory with mode 0700 (store.go:73,76; round.go:165). On the next Save of a run, chmod an existing run directory to 0700. Do not chmod on load, and do not chmod a file a vendor CLI wrote. Update docs/state.md with the modes. Decided 2026-10-23 (owner interview): 0700; tighten on next save; leave vendor files. Nothing is open. Write the tests first and watch them fail.
